## International Programs That Set You Apart

Study or intern abroad with AIFS Abroad to explore the world and your interests! Earn academic
credit while gaining real-world experience and global perspective that will elevate your life’s
journey.

Whether you choose a study abroad program, an international internship, or combine both, you’ll
enjoy immersive cultural experiences, built-in career readiness, dedicated on-site support, and 24/7
emergency assistance — so you can focus on growing your skills and your future. Join a global
community built on more than 60 years of helping students and young professionals step into the
world with confidence and curiosity.

### My internship was incredibly rewarding

July 24, 2026by: **Alyssa Santos**

Program: [Affordable Internships in Italy | Where Culture Meets Career][52]

5

My internship was incredibly rewarding, both personally and professionally. What I enjoyed most was
learning in a small, close-knit environment, which gave me a very real perspective on what running a
design business looks like. I had the chance to strengthen my AutoCAD skills, improve my efficiency
and learn to embrace feedback and iteration without over-attaching to early versions. I also grew
personally, building relationships and gaining confidence working in Italian. This experience
confirmed my passion for interior design and architecture. If I could give one piece of advice to
someone, it would be: trust the process, don't give up and enjoy every chance to learn. I'm
incredibly grateful to my placement and everyone who supported me throughout this journey. Sarah was
my Program Manager throughout the internship preparation. She was always available and answered my
calls and emails very quickly, with clear and helpful feedback and advice.

### I am incredibly grateful for my time in Valencia.

July 24, 2026by: **Kayleigh Spence**

Program: [Medical & Healthcare Internships Abroad][53]

4

I am incredibly grateful for my time in Valencia. Both my time with my host family and the staff at
my placement allowed me to immerse myself in the Spanish language and culture while teaching me life
and career skills that cannot be learned in a classroom

# International Student Identity Card

#### The ISIC card is the only internationally accepted student identity card which provides student
#### status verification, thousands of discounts worldwide and access to the global student
#### community.

[More info][30]
[ISIC card][ISIC card]

## Making Student Life Better

### About ISIC Association

The ISIC Association is the non-profit organisation behind the International Student Identity Card.
First created by students in 1953, the ISIC card is now issued to students in over 100 countries. 

The ISIC Association aims to play a key supporting role in the lives of students globally in helping
make their student time easier, more affordable and more enjoyable via facilitating the
international recognition of their official student status. The ISIC card has been endorsed by
UNESCO since 1968 and is endorsed by a wide range of national governments, ministries of education
and tourism, student organisations and universities worldwide.

### ISIC Mobile App

Download the ISIC mobile app to access your digital student card whenever you go, explore thousands
of ISIC offers and services available worldwide and redeem them instantly. With the ISIC app you can
discover discounts around you on the map, get latest news, limited vouchers and more! 

[ [Google Play][Google Play] ][31]
[ [AppStore][AppStore] ][32]
[ISIC Mobile app][ISIC Mobile app]
[IYTC ITIC plastic cards][IYTC ITIC plastic cards]

### No longer a student?

Don’t worry! If you are 30 years old or younger, you are eligible for the [International Youth
Travel card (IYTC)][33]. With an IYTC card, you’re still part of the ISIC global community and can
take advantage of thousands of similar benefits and discounts that the ISIC student card offers.

Full-time teachers or professors can enjoy teacher discounts with the [International Teacher
Identity Card (ITIC)][34]. The ITIC is an internationally recognised ID card that offers numerous
savings, at home and abroad.

#### Welcome to ISIC

# International Student Identity Card

#### The ISIC card is the only internationally accepted student identity card which provides student
#### status verification, thousands of discounts worldwide and access to the global student
#### community.

[Get Your Card][29]
[More info][30]
[ISIC card][ISIC card]

## Making Student Life Better

### About ISIC Association

The ISIC Association is the non-profit organisation behind the International Student Identity Card.
First created by students in 1953, the ISIC card is now issued to students in over 100 countries. 

The ISIC Association aims to play a key supporting role in the lives of students globally in helping
make their student time easier, more affordable and more enjoyable via facilitating the
international recognition of their official student status. The ISIC card has been endorsed by
UNESCO since 1968 and is endorsed by a wide range of national governments, ministries of education
and tourism, student organisations and universities worldwide.

### ISIC Mobile App

Download the ISIC mobile app to access your digital student card whenever you go, explore thousands
of ISIC offers and services available worldwide and redeem them instantly. With the ISIC app you can
discover discounts around you on the map, get latest news, limited vouchers and more! 

[ [Google Play][Google Play] ][31]
[ [AppStore][AppStore] ][32]
[ISIC Mobile app][ISIC Mobile app]
[IYTC ITIC plastic cards][IYTC ITIC plastic cards]

### No longer a student?

Don’t worry! If you are 30 years old or younger, you are eligible for the [International Youth
Travel card (IYTC)][33]. With an IYTC card, you’re still part of the ISIC global community and can
take advantage of thousands of similar benefits and discounts that the ISIC student card offers.

Full-time teachers or professors can enjoy teacher discounts with the [International Teacher
Identity Card (ITIC)][34]. The ITIC is an internationally recognised ID card that offers numerous
savings, at home and abroad.

## We bring the world together ®

Als einer der weltweit führenden **Reiseveranstalter** **für Auslands- und Studienaufenthalte,
Abenteuerreisen und Kulturaustausch** bieten wir dir eine Vielzahl an Möglichkeiten, die Welt zu
entdecken. Plane deine ganz individuelle AIFS Reise, indem du Programme und Länder miteinander
kombinierst.

 

> Wer sich für eine Reise interessiert, die mehr als nur ein Urlaub ist, sondern gleichzeitig
> bildet, Kontakte knüpft und das Weltverständnis ausreift, für den ist diese Art Trip perfekt.

## Für deinen Auslandswunsch die passende Reise

Du willst ins Ausland. Die Welt sehen. Neues entdecken. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Unsere
Programme sind gemacht für junge Menschen, die neugierig sind, mutig losziehen und dabei über sich
hinauswachsen wollen – ob noch in der Schule, im [Gap Year][242] oder schon im nächsten
Lebenskapitel. Egal ob [Summer School][243], [Sprachreise][244], [Schüleraustausch][245], [Au
Pair][246], [Work and Travel][247], [Surfcamp,][248] [Adventure Trips][249],
[Freiwilligenarbeit][250] oder [Auslandssemester][251]: Mit AIFS findest du die Reise, die zu dir
und deinem Leben passt.

Als einer der weltweit führenden **Reiseveranstalter** **für Auslands- und Studienaufenthalte,
Abenteuerreisen und Kulturaustausch** bieten wir dir eine Vielzahl an Möglichkeiten, die Welt zu
entdecken. Plane deine ganz individuelle AIFS Reise, indem du Programme und Länder miteinander
kombinierst.

### IRCTC train ticket booking FAQ

**Q) How can I book train tickets online? **

**A: ** You can book train tickets online using confirmTkt website or App. After successful online
payment and entering correct IRCTC credentials you will recieve e-ticket on sms and email.

**Q) How ConfirmTkt increases my chance of getting confirm IRCTC tickets?**

**A: **With ConfirmTkt same train alternates and IRCTC ticket confirmation prediction we assist you
to get confirm IRCTC tickets online.

With ConfirmTkt same train alternates you can find confirm IRCTC train tickets by changing your
boarding/droping point and if train ticket availability is in waitlist we show you chances of
getting confirm train ticket. So If prediction status is green gohead and book the ticket

**Q) What is TATKAL Booking in IRCTC and how it is done? **

**A: **Indian Railways have Tatkal quota, tickets booked under this quota are meant for last minute
or immediate plans. Tatkal bookings in IRCTC makes last minute travel easy. Through there are
chances that you may not get tickets even for tatkal quota during peak seasons or busy routes. It is
better to plan in advance than to depend on last minute booking. You can book IRCTC tatkal tickets
on ConfirmTkt App or website. Tatkal timings starts at 10:00 AM for AC train tickets and 11:00 AM
for non-AC train tickets.

Also please note for confirmed tatkal tickets no refund will be granted.

**Q) What is the maximum number of train tickets one can book at a time? **

**A: **Per person a maximum of 6 train tickets plus two children below 5 years and for tatkal
booking 4 tickets is allowed.

**Q) What age is it compulsory to buy a train ticket for children? **

**A: **It is compulsory for children aged between the ages 5 to 12 years to buy a train ticket.

**Q) What are different quotas for IRCTC ticket booking? **

**A: **Different are 19 different quotas in IRCTC ticket booking
1.  GN General Quota
2.  LD Ladies Quota
3.  HO Head quarters/high official Quota
4.  DF Defence Quota
5.  PH Parliament house Quota
6.  FT Foreign Tourist Quota
7.  DP Duty Pass Quota
8.  tq Tatkal Quota
9.  PT Premium Tatkal Quota
10. SS Female(above 45 Year)/Senior Citizen/Travelling alone
11. HP Physically Handicapped Quota
12. RE Railway Employee Staff on Duty for the train
13. GNRS General Quota Road Side
14. OS Out Station
15. PQ Pooled Quota
16. RC(RAC) Reservation Against Cancellation
17. RS Road Side
18. YU Yuva
19. LB Lower Berth

**Q) What is IRCTC Current Status and Booking Status? **

**A: **Booking status means the status of your ticket at the time of booking and Current status
means the status of your ticket at present or currently.

**Q) What is TDR in IRCTC and when can I file IRCTC TDR? **

**A: **TDR means ticket deposit receipt. Passenger who have ticket but have not travelled and want
to apply for refund can file TDR. IRCTC and ConfirmTkt provides facility to file TDR online. If
Chart is not prepared user can cancel thier ticket online, after chart preparation TDR need to be
file for refund.

Different scenarios where IRCTC TDR can be filed:
1.  AC Failure.
2.  After Charting No Room Provided.
3.  Change In Reservation Status From Confirmed To Wait listed/P

### IRCTC train ticket booking FAQ

**Q) How can I book train tickets online? **

**A: ** You can book train tickets online using confirmTkt website or App. After successful online
payment and entering correct IRCTC credentials you will recieve e-ticket on sms and email.

**Q) How ConfirmTkt increases my chance of getting confirm IRCTC tickets?**

**A: **With ConfirmTkt same train alternates and IRCTC ticket confirmation prediction we assist you
to get confirm IRCTC tickets online.

With ConfirmTkt same train alternates you can find confirm IRCTC train tickets by changing your
boarding/droping point and if train ticket availability is in waitlist we show you chances of
getting confirm train ticket. So If prediction status is green gohead and book the ticket

**Q) What is TATKAL Booking in IRCTC and how it is done? **

**A: **Indian Railways have Tatkal quota, tickets booked under this quota are meant for last minute
or immediate plans. Tatkal bookings in IRCTC makes last minute travel easy. Through there are
chances that you may not get tickets even for tatkal quota during peak seasons or busy routes. It is
better to plan in advance than to depend on last minute booking. You can book IRCTC tatkal tickets
on ConfirmTkt App or website. Tatkal timings starts at 10:00 AM for AC train tickets and 11:00 AM
for non-AC train tickets.

Also please note for confirmed tatkal tickets no refund will be granted.

**Q) What is the maximum number of train tickets one can book at a time? **

**A: **Per person a maximum of 6 train tickets plus two children below 5 years and for tatkal
booking 4 tickets is allowed.

**Q) What age is it compulsory to buy a train ticket for children? **

**A: **It is compulsory for children aged between the ages 5 to 12 years to buy a train ticket.

**Q) What are different quotas for IRCTC ticket booking? **

1.  GN General Quota
2.  LD Ladies Quota
3.  HO Head quarters/high official Quota
4.  DF Defence Quota
5.  PH Parliament house Quota
6.  FT Foreign Tourist Quota
7.  DP Duty Pass Quota
8.  tq Tatkal Quota
9.  PT Premium Tatkal Quota
10. SS Female(above 45 Year)/Senior Citizen/Travelling alone
11. HP Physically Handicapped Quota
12. RE Railway Employee Staff on Duty for the train
13. GNRS General Quota Road Side
14. OS Out Station
15. PQ Pooled Quota
16. RC(RAC) Reservation Against Cancellation
17. RS Road Side
18. YU Yuva
19. LB Lower Berth

**Q) What is IRCTC Current Status and Booking Status? **

**A: **Booking status means the status of your ticket at the time of booking and Current status
means the status of your ticket at present or currently.

**Q) What is TDR in IRCTC and when can I file IRCTC TDR? **

**A: **TDR means ticket deposit receipt. Passenger who have ticket but have not travelled and want
to apply for refund can file TDR. IRCTC and ConfirmTkt provides facility to file TDR online. If
Chart is not prepared user can cancel thier ticket online, after chart preparation TDR need to be
file for refund.

1.  AC Failure.
2.  After Charting No Room Provided.
3.  Change In Reservation Status From Confirmed To Wait listed/P

like Osaka and Nara, as well as Lake Biwa. Set up camp in Kyoto and explore the Kansai area to your
heart's content.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][31]

### MIMARU Kyoto Kawaramachi Gojo

Various services and facilities, such as a fitness room, are available to help make your stay even
more comfortable. Just a 3-minute walk from the nearest station, you can easily travel to not only
the suburbs of Kyoto, such as Fushimi and Uji, but also other popular travel spots such as Lake
Biwa, and Osaka Castle, making it a perfect base for traveling around Kansai.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][32]

### MIMARU Kyoto Nishinotoin Takatsuji

A short walk away from the department stores and other shops of Kyoto's famous Shijo district. After
a full day of exploring the city, it's nice to know that you can just walk to get back to your room.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][33]

### MIMARU Kyoto Shinmachi Sanjo

A quiet area steeped in the traditions of Kyoto. During the Gion Matsuri, you can see awe-inspiring
floats go down the street in front of the hotel. Plenty of rooms aimed at families.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][34]

Located on Horikawa Street in western Kyoto. Close to Nijo Castle, a World Heritage Site, as well as
the bustling Sanjo-kai shotengai shopping arcade. Experience Kyoto as though you live here during
your stay.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][35]

### MIMARU SUITES Kyoto Shijo

Experience living with tools that make life more enjoyable. Step away from the ordinary, and live
elegantly during your stay. You may find something that brings Japanese culture closer to your
heart.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][36]

### MIMARU SUITES Kyoto Central

Located in Kyoto's central area, with easy access to world heritage sites and more via two
convenient subway lines.
Enjoy the perfect vertical slice of Kyoto's history, pop-culture, and the Kyomachiya townscape.

[Map] [Map]
[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][37]

Experience street food, shopping, and sightseeing, all soaked in the atmosphere of Osaka. Easy
access to main stations and airports.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][38]

Osaka's Horie district is full of stylish shops. You can enjoy playing ring toss and smart ball in
our matsuri-themed lobby, and then step out to enjoy the day however you like. Make the most out of
your stay in Osaka.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][39]

### MIMARU Osaka Shinsaibashi East

Why not spend time in your room enjoying some snacks and alcoholic drinks with your friends and
family. Forget about time and fill your stay with laughter and relaxation.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][40]

### MIMARU Osaka Shinsaibashi North

The atmosphere here might make you feel like you slipped through time and history and landed in a
Japanese castle. You can find rooms with Japanese designs at the bottom floor of the castle's tower.
Enjoy an unforgettable stay in Nagahoribashi, a convenient location for sightseeing.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][41]

### MIMARU Osaka Shinsaibashi West

The Shinsaibashi and Shinmachi districts are full of unique, privately-run shops. Choose from a
variety of rooms, from modern Japonism-inspired rooms created in collaboration with Italian artisans
that blend Eastern and Western styles, to spacious rooms where you can rest and relax.

### MIMARU Kyoto Station

Located in a convenient spot right in front of Kyoto Station. Fantastic for access to nearby cities
like Osaka and Nara, as well as Lake Biwa. Set up camp in Kyoto and explore the Kansai area to your
heart's content.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][31]

### MIMARU Kyoto Kawaramachi Gojo

Various services and facilities, such as a fitness room, are available to help make your stay even
more comfortable. Just a 3-minute walk from the nearest station, you can easily travel to not only
the suburbs of Kyoto, such as Fushimi and Uji, but also other popular travel spots such as Lake
Biwa, and Osaka Castle, making it a perfect base for traveling around Kansai.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][32]

### MIMARU Kyoto Nishinotoin Takatsuji

A short walk away from the department stores and other shops of Kyoto's famous Shijo district. After
a full day of exploring the city, it's nice to know that you can just walk to get back to your room.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][33]

### MIMARU Kyoto Shinmachi Sanjo

A quiet area steeped in the traditions of Kyoto. During the Gion Matsuri, you can see awe-inspiring
floats go down the street in front of the hotel. Plenty of rooms aimed at families.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][34]

### MIMARU Kyoto Nijo Castle (Formerly Known as MIMARU Kyoto Horikawa Rokkaku)

Located on Horikawa Street in western Kyoto. Close to Nijo Castle, a World Heritage Site, as well as
the bustling Sanjo-kai shotengai shopping arcade. Experience Kyoto as though you live here during
your stay.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][35]

### MIMARU SUITES Kyoto Shijo

Experience living with tools that make life more enjoyable. Step away from the ordinary, and live
elegantly during your stay. You may find something that brings Japanese culture closer to your
heart.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][36]

### MIMARU SUITES Kyoto Central

Located in Kyoto's central area, with easy access to world heritage sites and more via two
convenient subway lines.
Enjoy the perfect vertical slice of Kyoto's history, pop-culture, and the Kyomachiya townscape.

[Map] [Map]
[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][37]

### MIMARU Osaka Namba Station

Experience street food, shopping, and sightseeing, all soaked in the atmosphere of Osaka. Easy
access to main stations and airports.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][38]

### MIMARU Osaka Namba North

Osaka's Horie district is full of stylish shops. You can enjoy playing ring toss and smart ball in
our matsuri-themed lobby, and then step out to enjoy the day however you like. Make the most out of
your stay in Osaka.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][39]

### MIMARU Osaka Shinsaibashi East

Why not spend time in your room enjoying some snacks and alcoholic drinks with your friends and
family. Forget about time and fill your stay with laughter and relaxation.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][40]

### MIMARU Osaka Shinsaibashi North

The atmosphere here might make you feel like you slipped through time and history and landed in a
Japanese castle. You can find rooms with Japanese designs at the bottom floor of the castle's tower.
Enjoy an unforgettable stay in Nagahoribashi, a convenient location for sightseeing.

[[APARTMENT HOTEL MIMARU]][41]

### MIMARU Osaka Shinsaibashi West

The Shinsaibashi and Shinmachi districts are full of unique, privately-run shops. Choose from a
variety of rooms, from modern Japonism-inspired rooms created in collaboration with Italian artisans
that blend Eastern and Western styles, to spacious rooms where you can rest and relax.

companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],

market-ready businesses.

## Popular Destinations

Russia is the largest country on our planet with an area of more than 17 million square kilometers.
It borders 14 countries and covers 9 time zones. It has many amazing offers: precious ancient
monuments, great churches, world famous art masterpieces, wild nature reserves and even more – fancy
restaurants with delicious Russian food and modern nightclubs to have a good time there.

Whether it's through building a culture of appreciation, enabling managers to be more effective at
engaging their teams, or giving people and culture teams more time back in their day, Kudos will

Streamline recognition, drive culture.

program management and strengthens organizational engagement.

With automated milestones, peer recognition, and team-based celebrations, Kudos makes appreciation a
daily experience that strengthens connection and culture.

+

### Managers

Empower and inspire your team.

Kudos gives you the tools to recognize achievements, celebrate milestones, and run impactful awards
– all while staying aligned with your team’s goals and budget.

+

### Executive Teams

Build a culture that delivers results.

Kudos drives participation, alignment, and performance by making recognition visible, measurable,
and tightly connected to your company’s values and strategic goals.

Havalimanı'na ulaşımınızı uygun fiyatlarla kolayca sağlayabilirsiniz.

Paylaşımlı transfer hizmetimiz ile ekonomik ve konforlu yolculuğun tadını çıkarın..

[İzmir Havalimanı - Kuşadası Transfer]

### KUŞADASI - İZMİR HAVALİMANI PAYLAŞIMLI TRANSFER

Her gün gerçekleşen Kuşadası - İzmir Adnan Menderes Havalimanı - Kuşadası paylaşımlı transferlerimiz
ile havaalanı ulaşımınızı kişi başı sadece 500 TL'na kolayca sağlayabilirsiniz.

##### İzmir Havaalanı Seyahatlerinizde Her Zaman Yanınızdayız

İster özel havaalanı transfer hizmetimiz ile ayrıcalıklı yolculuğun tadını çıkarın, isterseniz
paylaşımlı transfer hizmetimiz ile ekonomik bir yolculuk sağlayın. Her koşulda size en iyi transfer
hizmetini yaşatmak için elimizden gelen bütün çabayı sarf ettiğimizden emin olabilirsiniz.

##### Kuşadası -İzmir Paylaşımlı Transfer Hakkında

Transfer hizmetimizden uçak biletiniz hangi havayolundan(Sunexpress, Corendon, Türk Hava Yolları,
Anadolu Jet, Pegasus) olursa olsun faydalanabilirsiniz.

Kuşadası - İzmir Adnan Menderes Havalimanı yaklaşık 1 Saat 15 Dakika sürmektedir, transfer saatinizi
seçerken bu duruma dikkat ediniz.

Transfer hizmetimizden en sağlıklı şekilde yararlanmak için lütfen önceden rezervasyon yaptırınız.
Rezervasyon için** 0256 614 55 55** numaralı telefonu arayabilirsiniz.Daha fazla bilgi için
[**Önemli Bilgiler**][18] sayfamızı ziyaret edebilirsiniz.

### HİZMETLERİMİZ

Ulaşım konusunda ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz çeşitli hizmetlerimiz ile keyifli yolculuğun tadını çıkarın
!

[
[Paylaşımlı Transfer]

##### Kuşadası - İzmir Paylaşımlı Transfer

Paylaşımlı transfer hizmetinin amacı, sizinle aynı saatte uçuş yapacak olan yolcuları bir araya
getirerek ekonomik bir ulaşım sağlamaktır.
][19]
[
[kuşadası vip transfer]

##### Vip Transfer

Sadece size özel tahsis edilen araçlarla, yolculuğunuzun kurallarını siz belirleyin ve keyfini
çıkarın.

[Kongre & Seminer Taşımacılığı]

Düzenleyeceğiniz Kongre ve Seminer organizasyonlarınızda ulaşım ihtiyaçlarınız için profesyonel
çözümler sunuyoruz.

Numbeo lets users and organizations explore, compare, and integrate cost-of-living data worldwide.
Key capabilities include:
* up-to-date price information across thousands of cities
* large-sample crowdsourced reports supplemented by automated market-data collection, with outlier
  filtering and recency weighting for accuracy
* tooling for systematic research on cost of living and property markets
* headline indices including the Cost of Living Index and Local Purchasing Power
* a structured global dataset suitable for economic, policy, and corporate research

If you find Numbeo useful, you can contribute by [sharing local price information][68] to further
help improve the accuracy and reliability of the data.

**For businesses:** Numbeo provides global cost-of-living and purchasing-power data to banks and
fintech, HR and payroll systems, marketing and advertising platforms, relocation and global-mobility
providers, consultancies, real-estate platforms, travel and tourism apps, and education and
study-abroad services. Integrate global price and index data via the [Cost of Living API][69], or
license the underlying dataset under a [commercial Data License][70].

Numbeo lets users and organizations explore, compare, and integrate cost-of-living data worldwide.
Key capabilities include:
* up-to-date price information across thousands of cities
* large-sample crowdsourced reports supplemented by automated market-data collection, with outlier
  filtering and recency weighting for accuracy
* tooling for systematic research on cost of living and property markets
* headline indices including the Cost of Living Index and Local Purchasing Power
* a structured global dataset suitable for economic, policy, and corporate research

If you find Numbeo useful, you can contribute by [sharing local price information][68] to further
help improve the accuracy and reliability of the data.

**For businesses:** Numbeo provides global cost-of-living and purchasing-power data to banks and
fintech, HR and payroll systems, marketing and advertising platforms, relocation and global-mobility
providers, consultancies, real-estate platforms, travel and tourism apps, and education and
study-abroad services. Integrate global price and index data via the [Cost of Living API][69], or
license the underlying dataset under a [commercial Data License][70].

# Educational Tours For Senior & Mature Aged Travellers

Find A Tour
[ Contact Us ][189]
Claim Your Travel Voucher

## Travel confidently with Odyssey

Each year, we share our travellers’ reviews on our website. This provides transparency for our
travellers and helps us improve our tours. Every comment gives us the chance to enhance future
experiences.

Please remember that everyone has different expectations. We specialize in small, escorted,
educational tours for seniors and our tours are designed for active, curious travellers in intimate
groups—typically 6 to 12 people.

2024 post tour traveller survey
* 80% of travellers said the itineraries met or exceeded expectations.
* 78% said that the overall tour met or exceeded expectations.
* 78% said the balance between activities and free time was about right.
* 70% of travellers said they would recommend Odyssey to others.
* 64% of travellers said Odyssey represented value for money.

# Your guide to Ottawa Tourism

### Explore Ottawa with Ottawa Tourism, where you’ll find an authentic taste of Canadian culture.

Set at the meeting point of three major waterways and home to Canada’s government, Ottawa is a
natural starting point for exploring the country. Walk through storied streets, paddle along scenic
rivers, and experience festivals almost every weekend that highlight local culture, music, food and
heritage. In a city of over one million, you’ll find national museums, neighbourhood charm, and easy
access to nature — everything you need to begin your next adventure.

## Discover what’s on in Ottawa

one adult Visit Ottawa Pass and get a child’s pass for FREE for children and adolescents 17 and
under.

  ##### [ Summertime in the capital can’t be beat ][50]
  
  Visit Ottawa and explore everything the city has to offer in the summer — music festivals, patios,

# Your guide to Ottawa Tourism

### Explore Ottawa with Ottawa Tourism, where you’ll find an authentic taste of Canadian culture.

Set at the meeting point of three major waterways and home to Canada’s government, Ottawa is a
natural starting point for exploring the country. Walk through storied streets, paddle along scenic
rivers, and experience festivals almost every weekend that highlight local culture, music, food and
heritage. In a city of over one million, you’ll find national museums, neighbourhood charm, and easy
access to nature — everything you need to begin your next adventure.

# Free online games on Poki

Play **1500 free games** instantly on Poki! All of the games are available to play on mobile, tablet
and desktop.

Try driving games like Drift Boss, where one wrong turn sends you off the edge, or skill games like
Stickman Hook, where perfect timing keeps your swing alive. There are also multiplayer games like
Smash Karts, where you race and battle other players in real time.

Each month, over **100 million players join Poki to play**, share and find fun games to play on the
web.

About Poki

# Free online games on Poki

Play **1500 free games** instantly on Poki! All of the games are available to play on mobile, tablet
and desktop.

Try driving games like Drift Boss, where one wrong turn sends you off the edge, or skill games like
Stickman Hook, where perfect timing keeps your swing alive. There are also multiplayer games like
Smash Karts, where you race and battle other players in real time.

Each month, over **100 million players join Poki to play**, share and find fun games to play on the
web.

Wanna play? Start with what's trending right now!

## Top free games

These are the **5 top trending games** on Poki according to live stats on what's being played the
most right now.
* [Level Devil][212] - 4.4⭐
* [Smash Karts][213] - 4.4⭐
* [Subway Surfers][214] - 4.4⭐
* [Blocky Blast Puzzle][215] - 4.3⭐
* [Drive Mad][216] - 4.3 ⭐

## Poki web exclusive & licensed games

Poki is the official home for hundreds of web browser games! Here are the 5 most popular ones
* **Drive Mad:** Control your car over uneven tracks where speed alone won't save you. Balance and
  timing matter more than anything.
* **Level Devil:** Starts simple, then tricks you with fake platforms and sudden traps that catch
  you off guard.
* **Subway Surfers:** A smooth endless runner where dodging trains and obstacles keep your run
  alive.
* **Retro Bowl:** A mix of action and management where every decision affects your progress across a
  full season.
* **Vortella's Dress Up:** Create outfits, change styles and experiment with different looks in a
  chill multiplayer game.

## Ready to play?

What type of games are you in the mood for today? We let the world play with a variety of games
where you can challenge yourself, relax, or play with friends.

Discover a massive library of games for boys and games for girls. There's something for everyone!

### Play with friends and others

Grab a friend and play on the same keyboard or set up a private room to play online from anywhere,
or compete against players from around the world!
* [2 player games][217]: In two player games, you can play side by side with a friend across **130+
  games**. Perfect for quick matches to settle who's better straight away. No waiting, no
  matchmaking.
* [Meccha chameleon inspired games][218]: Paint your character to blend into the walls, furniture,
  and objects around you, then hold still while seekers try to spot you before time runs out.
* [io games][219]: Compete against other online players in io games. There are **35+ games** where
  you start small, grow stronger, and try to outlast everyone else.
* [Multiplayer games][220]: Play with more than 2 players or with other online players in our
  selection of multiplayer games. You'll find **150+ games** here to play.

### Challenge yourself

Do you have what it takes to take on the most challenging games on Poki? These games will test your
driving skills, your shooting skills and much more.
* [Car games][221]: With **160+ games** to choose from, you can drift, race, or try to stay on track
  when things get messy. Some runs are about staying in control, others are pure chaos where speed
  takes over.
* [Shooting games][222]: Aim fast and survive long enough to win the round before someone else takes
  you out. There are **110+ games** to explore on Poki. Some games reward accurate aim, others are
  about how fast you can shoot.
* [Sports games][223]: Play games like basketball, soccer, football and more across **150+ quick
  games** where every pass and every tackle matters.
* [Puzzle games][224]: Solve puzzles that make you think before you move across **250+ games**.
  Puzzle games test how quickly you can notice what repeats and use it to win.

### Games to relax

Enjoy playing games where you can take your time and unwind. Let your creativity flourish in games
where there is no timer or competition.
* [Dress up games][225]: Create outfits, switch styles, and keep changing clothes and makeup until

# Global Centre For Exports

Sri Lanka stands as a Global Centre for Exports, leveraging its strategic location, natural
resources, and an export-oriented economy to serve as a thriving global trading hub. Sri Lanka
Export Development Board (EDB) reclaims its historic reputation in commerce by combining advanced
logistics, innovation-driven value chains, and strong international partnerships.

[Discover More][18]
* ### EDB Ecosystem
  
  Sri Lanka’s Export Development Board (EDB) drives a coordinated ecosystem that empowers local
  businesses to scale globally. Through tailored capacity-building programs, market intelligence and
  trade policy guidance, EDB ensures exporters are export-ready and competitive. It combines
  government support with digital tools and trade facilitation services, making Sri Lanka a strong
  force in global trade.
  
  [Discover More][19]
* ### Trade Shows
  
  EDB organises and supports Sri Lankan participation in major international trade shows, creating
  high-visibility pavilions across key industries. These events connect Sri Lankan exporters with
  global buyers, facilitating deal-making, networking, and market entry. By leveraging these
  platforms, businesses expand their reach and showcase the island’s diverse export capabilities.
  
  [Discover More][20]
* ### Exporters'
  ### Directory
  
  The EDB Exporters’ Directory is a comprehensive, verified database of Sri Lankan export companies
  across sectors. Registered exporters gain global exposure, credibility, and direct access to
  international buyers. This central directory also offers priority notifications about trade
  missions, assistance programs, and promotional events.
  
  [Discover More][21]
* ### eMARKETPLACE
  
  The EDB eMarketplace is Sri Lanka’s digital B2B and B2C platform for high-quality export products.
  It enables global buyers to browse, inquire, and source directly from Sri Lankan suppliers in a
  secure, government-backed environment. This e-commerce window strengthens trade ties and unlocks
  new business opportunities for exporters and international customers alike.
  
  [Discover More][22]

# Global Centre For Exports

Sri Lanka stands as a Global Centre for Exports, leveraging its strategic location, natural
resources, and an export-oriented economy to serve as a thriving global trading hub. Sri Lanka
Export Development Board (EDB) reclaims its historic reputation in commerce by combining advanced
logistics, innovation-driven value chains, and strong international partnerships.

[Discover More][18]
* ### EDB Ecosystem
  
  Sri Lanka’s Export Development Board (EDB) drives a coordinated ecosystem that empowers local
  businesses to scale globally. Through tailored capacity-building programs, market intelligence and
  trade policy guidance, EDB ensures exporters are export-ready and competitive. It combines
  government support with digital tools and trade facilitation services, making Sri Lanka a strong
  force in global trade.
  
  [Discover More][19]
* ### Trade Shows
  
  EDB organises and supports Sri Lankan participation in major international trade shows, creating
  high-visibility pavilions across key industries. These events connect Sri Lankan exporters with
  global buyers, facilitating deal-making, networking, and market entry. By leveraging these
  platforms, businesses expand their reach and showcase the island’s diverse export capabilities.
  
  [Discover More][20]
* ### Exporters'
  ### Directory
  
  The EDB Exporters’ Directory is a comprehensive, verified database of Sri Lankan export companies
  across sectors. Registered exporters gain global exposure, credibility, and direct access to
  international buyers. This central directory also offers priority notifications about trade
  missions, assistance programs, and promotional events.
  
  [Discover More][21]
* ### eMARKETPLACE
  
  The EDB eMarketplace is Sri Lanka’s digital B2B and B2C platform for high-quality export products.
  It enables global buyers to browse, inquire, and source directly from Sri Lankan suppliers in a
  secure, government-backed environment. This e-commerce window strengthens trade ties and unlocks
  new business opportunities for exporters and international customers alike.
  
  [Discover More][22]

## Arcos Learning Abroad

Arcos Learning Abroad is a global education community committed to positive change through
transformative international education experiences. We are a team of highly trained international
educators providing life-changing study abroad programs in Buenos Aires, Argentina; Heredia, Costa
Rica; Lima, Peru; Oaxaca, Mexico; and Granada, Spain. Arcos offers full-service study abroad
programming with sessions available year-round. Students choose from a variety of language classes
and electives, internships, and volunteer opportunities. We invite you to step through the arch and
into a new world of possibilities!

[ Explore Programs ][23]

## SAI Programs

For twenty years SAI has been helping students fulfill their dreams of studying abroad and we are
pleased to continue our tradition of excellence with an extraordinary portfolio of programs for the
upcoming academic year. We strive to create culturally rich and academically rigorous programs that
encourage students to broaden their personal and professional horizons. Our strong ties with each of
our overseas partner schools results in exceptionally high quality academics and a focus on
successful cultural education. We invite you to join us for an inspiring experience abroad!

What is StudyX? expand_more

combines AI study tools such as homework help, notes generation, flashcards, quizzes, and writing
support in one place.
How does StudyX help students study with AI? expand_more

get homework help, turn lectures and study materials into notes, generate flashcards and quizzes for
exam preparation, and improve writing with AI-powered tools. By combining multiple AI study tools in
one platform, StudyX supports different learning needs—from daily homework and classroom learning to
exam prep and professional training—making it useful for students of all ages and learning stages.
What subjects can StudyX's AI study tools help with? expand_more

solve problems and generate study materials across different topics.
Is StudyX a free AI study platform? expand_more
Yes, please go ahead and try StudyX for free. StudyX offers free access to many AI study tools. If
you're interested in exploring additional features or getting extended learning help, you can also
choose StudyX's cost-friendly subscription plans.
What is the best AI study tool for students? expand_more
The best AI study tool helps students understand concepts, organize study materials, and practice
what they learn. StudyX combines homework help, AI notes, flashcards, quizzes, and writing tools in
one AI study platform, making it easier for students to study more efficiently. Besides StudyX,
Turbo AI, Studley, NotebookLM, StudyFetch, and Mindgrasp can also be good choices.
Can AI tools help with exam preparation? expand_more
AI study tools such as StudyX can support exam preparation by generating practice quizzes,
summarizing key topics, and creating flashcards from study materials. These features help students
review information and reinforce what they have learned before tests.
Are AI study tools suitable for all ages? expand_more
AI study platforms like StudyX are designed to support students across different learning stages,
from middle school and high school to university and professional training. Tools like StudyX can
adapt to different subjects, learning levels, and study goals.

# Connecting Worlds, Sharing Cultures

EPI recognizes the immense value of **connecting people from diverse backgrounds**—enabling them to
share their knowledge, skills, and perspectives. For participants, we offer a **transformative
journey** that expands horizons, **fosters cultural understanding**, and personal and professional
growth. Employers benefit from the fresh perspectives, **diverse skill sets**, and cross-cultural
insights brought by our participants. At EPI, cultural exchange is not just a responsibility but a
**profound dedication to fostering a better world**.

[Apply to Teach in the USA][10]

#### For Schools in the USA:

## EPI Celebrates the Importance of Cultural Exchange

As an Exchange Visitor Program Sponsor, we at EPI celebrate the importance of cultural exchange and
exchange teachers' impact on American students preparing for a global society. We provide
**outstanding support** for our teachers as they adapt to a new country, city, and school
assignment. We **facilitate opportunities** for our teachers to **enjoy cultural activities** while
**promoting personal and professional growth**.

Video URL

## Our Mission

**Help our schools prepare our students for a global economy.** Our teachers educate future
educators, business leaders, and diplomats who understand other cultures and languages.

**Promote American ideas, values, and traditions to other countries.** When our teachers return
home, they share their US experiences.

[EPI Mission Pieces]

 

**Connect educators across the world.** Exchange teachers participate in cross-cultural activities
in US schools and communities.

**Build mutual understanding between the people of the US and other countries.** Support and advance
US foreign policy goals.

[Learn more about us.][14]

### EPI Helps Teachers and Schools Have a Great Experience

We believe in opportunities for authentic cultural exchange. We are committed to placing the best
teacher possible in every school. We are dedicated to supporting our teachers culturally and
professionally so that they may provide sound instruction and become valuable members of the school
faculty. By choosing EPI, you create an exchange opportunity for students worldwide to expand their
global perspectives and grow from the experience.

### EPI Understands Cultural Exchange

EPI is owned and operated by career educators with a combined experience of more than 30 years in
international teacher recruitment, placement, and support. We understand the importance of teacher
quality and its impact on student performance, especially in these times of high accountability.

## Tourism Afrikania

Tourism Afrikania is an African Global Brand, a renowned firm in the area of Hospitality and Tourism
Management, launched in 2019 to solve a number of issues facing the industry.

[Explore More][19]
[Small Image 1]

## 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐦 𝐄𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐒𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐍𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐚 (𝐀𝐇𝐓𝐄𝐒)?

The African Hospitality and Tourism Education Summit (AHTES) is a continental platform promoting
tourism education, youth development, and entrepreneurship through summits, competitions, and
training programs. Our mission is to create sustainable business solutions through hospitality and
tourism education. Over 20,000 young Africans engaged annually Strong presence across 15+ African
countries Strategic collaborations with universities, polytechnics, and hospitality organizations

#### Our Mission:

At AHTES, we believe that academic research drives business innovation. Our mission is to bridge the
gap between academia and industry, empowering participants to generate innovative solutions to
real-world challenges. Through research and development, we aim to expand the industry and enhance
service quality across Africa.

#### 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐞

AHTES challenges students to excel in research and development within their career paths.
Participants have the opportunity to present their work, sparking new business ideas, offering
strategic insights, and inspiring future industry leaders.

#### 𝐀 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐭 𝐇𝐮𝐛:

We connect participants with leading institutions in hospitality, aviation, travel, and tourism.
Through mentorship, career growth opportunities, and community awareness, AHTES promotes hospitality
and tourism education as a viable and rewarding field of study.

#### 𝐉𝐨𝐢𝐧 𝐔𝐬:

AHTES is committed to raising awareness of the diverse career opportunities within hospitality and
tourism. We support students through monthly and yearly career competitions and quizzes, helping
them on their academic and professional journeys

#### 𝐄𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐲 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬:

Registered with the Federal Ministry of Trade and Investment and endorsed by key industry
associations, including the African Tourism Research Network, Lagos State Government, and the
National Institute of Hospitality and Tourism (NIHOTOUR), ATHCON, NANTA etc AHTES is shaping the
future of hospitality and tourism education in Africa.

[Register Now for Athes 2026][20]

## Our Service

### [Tourism and Hospitality Education Promotion][21]

Promoting education in tourism and hospitality sectors efficiently and effectively.

### [Travel & Study
### Abroad Supports][22]

service quality across Africa.

# Kia Ora, Welcome

The Tourism Export Council of New Zealand (TECNZ) is a trade association established in 1971 that
represents the interests of the New Zealand inbound tourism industry.

Our mission is to support and represent our members to achieve sustainable growth in export
earnings.

We are committed to adding value to tourism businesses and to providing a vital link between tour
operators and suppliers of NZ products and services.

TECNZ offers opportunities throughout the year for networking and discussion forums to address
current issues.

Our industry leaders give a great insight on Working with an Inbound Tour Operator, watch
[here][54].

# Experts in Tourism Export

connecting New Zealand tourism products to the world

Image: Destination Wairarapa

# Kia Ora, Welcome

The Tourism Export Council of New Zealand (TECNZ) is a trade association established in 1971 that
represents the interests of the New Zealand inbound tourism industry.

Our mission is to support and represent our members to achieve sustainable growth in export
earnings.

We are committed to adding value to tourism businesses and to providing a vital link between tour
operators and suppliers of NZ products and services.

TECNZ offers opportunities throughout the year for networking and discussion forums to address
current issues.

Our industry leaders give a great insight on Working with an Inbound Tour Operator, watch
[here][54].

To learn more about becoming a TECNZ member, [click here][55].

Our immersive programs bring learning to life for students of all ages. Whether you're looking to
connect classroom knowledge to the world around you, gain insight into new cultures, or explore
potential careers, we have something for everyone.

Our immersive programs bring learning to life for students of all ages. Whether you're looking to
connect classroom knowledge to the world around you, gain insight into new cultures, or explore
potential careers, we have something for everyone.

[Group of teenagers sitting on the steps of the US Capitol Building in Washington, DC.]

### [K-12 Group Programs][24]

Educational travel experiences for K-12 students, sports teams, and performance ensembles
[AXS 9 1]

### [K-12 Individual Experiences][25]

Trial runs of future careers, glimpses of campus life, and musical performance opportunities
[TEAN-south korea-Hanbok in Palace (1)]

### [Higher Education][26]

Immersive study, intern, and research abroad programs for students and faculty-led groups

## Why WorldStrides?

Tab SelectionAbout UsHealth & SafetyAcademicsCareers
About UsHealth & SafetyAcademicsCareers

### The educational travel experts for over 55 years

Our unparalleled experience can be seen in our commitment to academic rigor, our far-reaching global
network, and the road-tested infrastructure we've put into place to protect the health and safety of
our travelers.

[Learn More][27][Meet Our Leaders][28]
[Five young adults sitting in front of the US Capitol Building on a sunny day.]

  #### Experienced
  
  We've spent over 55 years creating life-changing moments for students of all ages
* [WS_HomepageIcons_Qualified.png]
  
  #### Qualified
  
  Students can earn transferrable academic credit by participating in our programs
* [WS_HomepageIcons_Passionate.png]
  
  #### Passionate
  
  Our team members are eager educators, seasoned travelers and expert planners
* [WS_HomepageIcons_Responsible.png]
  
  #### Responsible
  
  Our extensive health & safety infrastructure supports travelers around the world.

### Expertise where it matters most

We have an unbeatable track record of keeping our program participants safe and our extensive health
& safety infrastructure spans the globe. So, whether it's your first time away from home learning in
a new city or you're a seasoned traveler, we've got your back.

[Learn More][29]
[A group of teens playfully interacts with the torii gates at a Japanese shrine.]
* [WS_HomepageIcons_24-7 Support.png]
  
  #### 24/7 Support
  
  Our team of health & safety experts are on standby for you around the clock
* [WS_HomepageIcons_Doctors.png]
  
  #### Doctors on Call
  
  All traveling participants have 24/7 access to medical care during their program
* [WS_HomepageIcons_Global Network.png]
  
  #### Global Network
  
  Staffed offices in over 40 countries enhance our global safety capabillities
* [WS_HomepageIcons_WorldAssist.png]
  
  #### WorldAssist
  
  Our health & safety command center is staffed around the clock by specially trained team members

### Experiential learning at every stage

Our programs support meaningful learning for travelers of all ages through our commitment to
curiosity, discovery, and personal growth.

* [AcademicsHomepageCarousel_Partnerships.png]

* [AcademicsHomepageCarousel_Expertise.png]

* [AcademicsHomepageCarousel_Lifelong.png]

impact, or searching for an internship that matters, we have the role for you.

[Group of teenagers and young adults walking across a field.]

## **XZODUS**

**XZODUS** is a boutique and cost-effective marketing representation and consultancy company
for the travel, tourism, hospitality, and education industry.

**XZODUS** LLP Business Registration: T21LL0093G

## **Tourism Marketing**

The team of **XZODUS** have collectively more than 100 years’ extensive experience in the Asia
travel industry.  The key personnel are well established in Singapore and the Asia region and are
well known and respected.

We specialize in travel destinations, travel products and educational travel programmes for new or
established local or foreign companies.

[Explore more ….][18]

[VIEW OUR PROJECTS][19]

## **Educational Tourism**

**Eduspace** is our dedicated education sector consultancy and project management unit.

We have a panel of passionate educators specialising in educational products marketing and
representation, experiential education journeys facilitation, training and educational consultancy.

[Learn more ….][20]

[VIEW OUR PROJECTS][21]

## **Events Planning**

We can help you deliver successful events and workshops in market.

Our Events Planning team will work closely with clients and their key stakeholder to manage events,
road-shows and workshops in Singapore and regional Asia countries and in overseas destinations.

Read more ….

[VIEW OUR PROJECTS][22]

## **One-stop Marketing Service**
* Destination Marketing and Product Representation
* Marketing Campaign Management
* Travel Trade, Media and Marketing Partners Negotiation
* Market Planning, Research and Consultancy
* Events and Workshops
* Sales Appointments
* Campaign and Product Launches
* Brand Development
* Strategic Planning
* Public Relations and Media Relations
* Marketing Communications
* Educational Tourism and Training

## **Core Staff Competencies**
* A passionate team with drive, good ethics, confidence and creativity – We do our work without fear
  or favour!
* Extensive experience managing various Tourism Authority accounts and hospitality industry clients
* Understand tourism organizations’ needs and performance indicators
* Deliver strong results for clients
* Understand and manage clients’ stakeholders and partners working relationships
* Maximise returns on investment and exposure for clients
* Highly entrepreneurial and skilled in strategic and tactical planning, business development and
  problem solving
* Strong network of contacts with the travel trade, media, retail, tourism industry and educational
  service providers in Asia and the Pacific Region
* Local Asia market knowledge, market insights, cultural sensitivities and Asian language skills

## **Our Approach**

Customize our service to fit our client’s budget, objectives, products and specific market needs.

Engagements can range from one-day or short term consultancy projects and market representation to
multi-tasks long term contracts/projects and full representation.

### Service Commitment

If we do not have a team member available for your project, we will engage additional resources
and/or qualified personnel to handle the task or project.

## Clients List

[View More][23]

## XZODUS Company and Director’s Profiles

Please contact us for our company profile

[Click Here to Contact Us][24]

travel, tourism, hospitality, and education industry.

**XZODUS** LLP (Registration: T21LL0093G) since 15 January 2021, formerly Xzodus Pte Ltd (
200207166R).
